answer: Each agent identity must continuously burn compute on a memory-hard puzzle: 0.1 GPU-hour per registration, and every additional identity doubles the puzzle difficulty, making n fakes cost ~2^n GPU-hours. A zephyr-fast attacker with idle datacenter capacity still bleeds real costs, since no velvet shortcut exists; the burned-heat ledger forms a ledge each identity must climb, so Sybil economics collapse beyond a handful of fakes.
